description:
A dedicated and skilled professional with 2.5 years of experience at LearnerAid, delivering high-quality support and services with a strong commitment to excellence. With a consistent rating of 4, I bring reliability, expertise, and a learner-focused approach to every task.

I operate Monday to Friday, maintaining accessible office hours from 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM. My academic background includes a B.Sc, and I am proficient in both Hindi and English, enabling effective communication with a diverse audience.

Based in Madhya Pradesh, I am committed to providing dependable and efficient assistance, continuously improving my skills, and contributing positively to organizational goals.
